name: Tessera Adaptive Marksman Platform TAMP-5 'Mimic'
description:
The TAMP-5 Mimic is a DMR with onboard AI that studies enemy marksmen's firing patterns and develops countermeasures in real-time. When engaged against an opposing designated marksman, the Mimic's AI analyzes incoming fire to determine the enemy's weapon type, estimated position, firing rhythm, and engagement tendencies. This analysis is presented to the operator as a BCI overlay showing the predicted timing and direction of the enemy's next shot.

The rifle fires 6.5mm caseless through a precision barrel and features a multi-sensor suite that detects incoming projectile signatures — supersonic crack analysis, ballistic trajectory backtracking, and thermal flash detection combine to build a model of the opposing shooter. The system improves with each exchanged shot, becoming more accurate in its predictions as the engagement continues.

Tessera markets the Mimic at Φ19,000 as a counter-sniper platform for designated marksmen who expect to face skilled opposition. The AI's ability to predict an enemy marksman's behavior creates an asymmetric advantage — the Mimic operator knows when and where the next shot is coming, while their opponent operates blind. In marksman-vs-marksman engagements, this information advantage is often decisive.
specifications:
caliber: 6.5mm caseless
effective_range: 800m
rate_of_fire: Semi-automatic
magazine_capacity: 20 rounds
weight: 5.0 kg
tactical_use: The Mimic transforms counter-sniper engagements by providing predictive intelligence about the opposing marksman. The AI's analysis of enemy firing patterns enables the operator to time their exposure between predicted enemy shots, move during the opponent's reload cycles, and identify the enemy's position through backtracked trajectories. In prolonged marksman duels, the Mimic's advantage compounds as the AI builds an increasingly accurate behavioral model.
cultural_context: The Mimic introduces an element of meta-cognition to precision shooting. The weapon doesn't just help the operator shoot — it helps them understand how their opponent thinks. This has created a new discipline in precision marksmanship: counter-prediction, where skilled marksmen deliberately vary their patterns to defeat AI analysis. The cat-and-mouse game between Mimic operators and pattern-aware opponents has become one of the most intellectually demanding aspects of modern precision combat.
story_hooks: Two Mimic operators were deployed against each other. Both AIs analyzed the other's patterns, creating an escalating prediction loop that resulted in both weapons recommending the exact same shot timing — the engagement ended in a simultaneous exchange that wounded both operators.

A marksman realized the Mimic's AI was being fed false data — the 'enemy marksman' was a decoy system broadcasting fake firing signatures to draw the operator into a position where the real threat was waiting.

physical_description.visual_profile: A sleek, modular DMR with an angular, almost geometric silhouette. The rifle has a pronounced sensor cluster mounted above the barrel in a raised cage-like structure, giving it an asymmetrical, predatory appearance. The overall design suggests precision engineering married to computational capacity — it looks like it *thinks* as much as it shoots.
physical_description.dimensions: Overall length: 112 cm | Barrel length: 55 cm | Width (with sensor array): 8 cm | Height (with optics mount): 14 cm
physical_description.weight_description: Hefty but balanced. At 5.0 kg, the weight is distributed across the sensor array and reinforced receiver, creating a rifle that feels planted and deliberate in the shoulder. Not light, but purposeful.
physical_description.primary_material: Aerospace-grade carbon composite chassis with reinforced aluminum receiver. Sensor array housing is brushed titanium alloy. Barrel is chrome-molybdenum steel.
physical_description.finish: Matte charcoal composite body with brushed titanium sensor cage. The receiver has a subtle satin finish to reduce glare. Heat-dispersal venting shows micro-etched cooling channels.
physical_description.color_scheme: Gunmetal gray primary with titanium-silver sensor array accents. Subtle teal indicator lights embedded in the sensor cluster. Polymer furniture in deep anthracite.
physical_description.grip_texture: Textured polymer grip with integrated sensor contact points — raised nodules that interface with shooter's palm biodata. Feels technical, almost circuit-like beneath the fingers.
distinctive_features: Prominent multi-sensor array cage above barrel housing thermal, ballistic trajectory, and supersonic analysis sensors
Recessed BCI interface port on the receiver (glows faint teal when powered)
Heat-dissipation vents along the barrel shroud with visible micro-etching
Modular quick-detach points for field sensor upgrades
Small LCD readout window in the rail system (displays targeting confidence %)
Caseless ammunition chamber with visible feed mechanism
Integrated shock absorber in the stock (visible pneumatic piston)
Cognitive Wellness Foundation holographic nameplate on the lower receiver
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: Cognitive Wellness Foundation logo (abstract neural network symbol) etched in brushed titanium on the left receiver side. Serial number laser-burned on the mag well. Small 'TAMP-5 MIMIC' designation on the dust cover in Eurostyle sans-serif font.
physical_description.condition_typical: Typically field-maintained in Tier 4 hands — clean sensor array, minor wear on grip texture, occasional scuff marks on the composite furniture from tactical harness friction. Heavily used examples show carbon scoring around the muzzle and slight discoloration from heat cycling.

image_prompt: Product photography of the Tessera TAMP-5 Mimic DMR mounted on a dark carbon-weave workbench, angled 45° to showcase the sensor array cage above the barrel. Dramatic side-lighting in cool teal and silver tones emphasizing the titanium sensor cluster and chrome-molybdenum barrel. Shallow depth of field with the sensor array in sharp focus, heat vents and integrated indicators clearly visible. Gloved hand (augmented with visible subcutaneous circuitry on wrist) grips the textured polymer furniture. Neo-noir urban aesthetic: sharp lines, precision engineering, faint LED glow in the BCI port. Dark studio background, perhaps subtle GLMZ cityscape bokeh in deep background. --ar 3:2 --v 6
